mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment, as measured by FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, as indicated by a high level of employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000 monthly additions), consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market slowdown (HOUST below 1000.0 thousand units), weak residential construction activity reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a severe economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from prior period, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
